relationships.description: Vettel changed the German flag stripe on his helmet to an Italian flag stripe in celebration of Ferrari's home race at the 2017 Italian Grand Prix.
Vettel wore a special helmet based on Lauda's final Ferrari helmet at the 2019 Monaco Grand Prix.
Vettel's final helmet design for the 2022 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix was nicknamed 'The Final Lap'.
